+package syncer
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+
+	searchv1beta1 "github.com/KusionStack/karpor/pkg/kubernetes/apis/search/v1beta1"
+	"github.com/go-logr/logr"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
+	fakediscovery "k8s.io/client-go/discovery/fake"
+	clienttesting "k8s.io/client-go/testing"
+)
+
+func Test_singleClusterSyncManager_resourceKind(t *testing.T) {
+	discoveryClient := &fakediscovery.FakeDiscovery{Fake: &clienttesting.Fake{}}
+	discoveryClient.Resources = []*metav1.APIResourceList{
+		{
+			GroupVersion: "networking.k8s.io/v1",
+			APIResources: []metav1.APIResource{
+				{Name: "ingresses", Kind: "Ingress"},
+				{Name: "ingresses/status", Kind: "Ingress"},
+				{Name: "networkpolicies", Kind: "NetworkPolicy"},
+			},
+		},
+		{
+			GroupVersion: "v1",
+			APIResources: []metav1.APIResource{
+				{Name: "endpoints", Kind: "Endpoints"},
+				{Name: "pods", Kind: "Pod"},
+			},
+		},
+	}
+	s := &singleClusterSyncManager{discoveryClient: discoveryClient, logger: logr.Discard()}
+
+	tests := []struct {
+		apiVersion string
+		resource   string
+		want       string
+	}{
+		{"networking.k8s.io/v1", "ingresses", "Ingress"},
+		{"networking.k8s.io/v1", "networkpolicies", "NetworkPolicy"},
+		{"v1", "endpoints", "Endpoints"},
+		{"v1", "pods", "Pod"},
+		{"v1", "unknowns", ""},
+		{"example.com/v1", "widgets", ""},
+	}
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.apiVersion+"/"+tt.resource, func(t *testing.T) {
+			rsr := &searchv1beta1.ResourceSyncRule{APIVersion: tt.apiVersion, Resource: tt.resource}
+			require.Equal(t, tt.want, s.resourceKind(rsr))
+		})
+	}
+}

+package utils
+
+// ResourceKind returns the kind used to query the stored resources of a sync rule.
+// kind is the Kind reported by API discovery for the resource; when it is unknown,
+// the resource name with its last letter removed is used, which only works for
+// plurals that are the kind plus an "s" (e.g. "pods").
+func ResourceKind(resource, kind string) string {
+	if kind != "" {
+		return kind
+	}
+	if resource == "" {
+		return ""
+	}
+	return resource[0 : len(resource)-1]
+}

+package utils
+
+import "testing"
+
+func TestResourceKind(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		resource string
+		kind     string
+		want     string
+	}{
+		{"ingresses", "Ingress", "Ingress"},
+		{"storageclasses", "StorageClass", "StorageClass"},
+		{"networkpolicies", "NetworkPolicy", "NetworkPolicy"},
+		{"endpoints", "Endpoints", "Endpoints"},
+		{"pods", "", "pod"},
+		{"", "", ""},
+	}
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		if got := ResourceKind(tt.resource, tt.kind); got != tt.want {
+			t.Errorf("ResourceKind(%q, %q) = %q, want %q", tt.resource, tt.kind, got, tt.want)
+		}
+	}
+}
